steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen.
Create a Technical Stage together with a pricing stage so the vendor technical-response submission flow is available.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
Add one line item for the technical and pricing event.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
Invite the QA vendor required for the response.
Publish the live Technical Stage event.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Assert the vendor submission was accepted by the portal.
Return to the vendor portal to inspect the submitted technical round.
Open the event's Technical Stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor portal shows the technical response as submitted.
Return to the buyer console to verify the recorded response.
Assert the buyer sees the vendor's direct Technical Stage response awaiting evaluation.
